title: Community Trade Day: Swap, Share & Support
description:
You’re Invited to our Community Trade Day!

Come out on June 28th from 10 AM – 4 PM at the Calvin Center Hall & Auditorium in Youngstown, Ohio for a powerful day of swapping, sharing, selling, and giving back! Clear out items you no longer need, discover new treasures, and help build a stronger, more connected community.



Admission is FREE for all attendees, and we welcome everyone to join in the fun!

- $15 table fee to participate — all proceeds support Mahoning Valley 
 Freedom Fighters’ community initiatives and upcoming events

- Items for sale must be priced under $50

- All vendors must be open to trading and donating items, not just selling

- This is a community-first event for mutual aid — no commercial reselling

- To reserve a table, email: Indivisiblefreedomfighters@gmail.com to speak with our coordinator

We’ll have dedicated donation tables collecting much-needed items for local families, including:

Healthcare products (toiletries, first aid, etc.)

Women’s products (pads, tampons, etc.)

Children's Necessities (diapers, baby wipes, etc.)

Children’s books & toys

Canned goods and non-perishables

Fresh vegetables and produce …and more!



RSVP today and help us make this a day of mutual aid, resource sharing, and radical love for our neighbors.


To host a table, email us at Indivisiblefreedomfighters@gmail.com to speak with our coordinator and get set up.

title: Roadside Rallies Against Fascism
description:
Join us for another Roadside Rally Against Fascism down in Bellmawr at the corner of Black Horse Pike and E Browning Road. 

There is a good amount of traffic and plenty of sidewalk, and there should be parking available on nearby residential streets (make sure not to obstruct the nearby police and fire departments on Lewis Ave). We would love to welcome as many folks as possible to come make some noise with us! 

This is a nonviolent demonstration, so please attend with safety and de-escalation in mind. We do not expect any counterprotestors, but we can never be 100% sure. Do your best to minimize engagement with hecklers, and don't be too shy to smile and wave at our supporters!

Please bring your signs, flags, street antics, and any other ways you can think of to joyfully disturb the peace. But please avoid any messaging that is outright hateful, violent, or discriminatory.

See you out there!

title: June Stop Voter Suppression Town Hall
description:
Anti-voter lawmakers and supporters of the SAVE Act and HJR B have introduced two petition drives that would make it harder for Michiganders to exercise their right to vote by introducing oppressive voter registration requirements.

The ballot initiatives proposed by the groups Committee to Protect Voters Rights' and Americans for Citizens Voting would require documentary proof of citizenship, creating chaos in our elections while blocking eligible voters from voting.

Both groups plan to start collecting signatures this summer to put these initiatives on the November 2026 ballot. Learn how VNP is fighting back against these harmful petitions and what you can do to protect voting rights in Michigan.

description:
Wonder how we got to such a dysfunctional political climate? Arthur Brooks explains it in this timely book, Love Your Enemies: How Decent People Can Save America From the Culture of Contempt. Breakout discussions on chapters that spoke to us most

Next steps . . . A plan to implement what we have learned from Brooks in our own lives

On June 6th, join thousands of veterans, military families, and their allies on the National Mall in Washington, D.C., for the Unite for Veterans, Unite for America Rally hosted by the AFL-CIO. America made a promise to its veterans. It's a promise we intend to keep.

Why We Rally Veterans and military family members are being fired by the thousands from federal jobs. Our healthcare is being gutted. Our benefits are under siege.

This isn't the first time veterans have had to fight for what was promised. From the Bonus Army of 1932 to the battles for the GI Bill and Agent Orange care, veterans have always led the charge for justice.

Now, it's our turn.

We rally to:

-Defend veteran and military family member employment in the federal workforce

-Stop the privatization and weakening of the Department of Veterans Affairs

-Hold political leaders accountable for policies that harm veterans and their families
